summary: OMNIA M3.S7 — Saved Searches + Alert Email Matching B2C. Backend 12/12 pytest GREEN (auth guards, CRUD, run preview, 10-search limit, cron admin gating). Frontend 11/11 Playwright flows GREEN (SaveSearchButton, login-gate redirect, save form, AccountDashboard with ss-row/freq/toggle/delete controls, empty state, access control). Email pipeline confirmed via backend logs: [EMAIL OK] template=saved_search_alert lang=it to=mcnicastro@gmail.com (run captured at 2026-06-23 08:32:43 — 1 search, 1 email sent, 1 match).

minor.issue: DocString in saved_searches.py and review_request both reference field name 'gdpr' but the actual Pydantic field is 'gdpr_consent'. Tests had to be corrected. Not a backend bug — only doc inconsistency to fix in the M3.S7 spec sheet.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Affects ImmocloudApp.jsx around line 375 where a <span> with style={{display:'contents'}} is rendered inside <option>. Does NOT break functionality but pollutes console with hydration error. Likely caused by ve-dynamic wrapper on dynamic option text.

tested_scenarios.email_pipeline_smoke: Backend logs show [EMAIL OK] to=mcnicastro@gmail.com template=saved_search_alert lang=it id=70f0c6c7-12b6-49cf-9a7d-235576dbb641 at 2026-06-23 08:32:43 followed by 'saved_searches cron: 11 searches, 1 emails sent, 1 total matches' — confirms run_all_active_saved_searches() + _send_alert_email() + Resend integration end-to-end. Resend test mode rejects non-admin recipients (expected; only mcnicastro@gmail.com whitelisted) which is why other b2csavedtest_* recipients hit [EMAIL ERROR] — NOT a code bug.
tested_scenarios.filter_matching_behavior: Implementation in _build_mongo_filter correctly reuses _base_filter() which excludes pending/rejected moderation states; applies $regex on city (case-insensitive prefix), exact match on operation/property_type/energy_class, $gte ranges for surface/rooms/bed/bath, and selects rent_monthly vs price based on operation. since>last_run_at filter applied on created_at confirmed in code.
tested_scenarios.last_run_at_dedupe: Confirmed in cron path: every active saved_search has last_run_at updated to now after each run (line 304-308), guaranteeing next run filters created_at > last_run_at.

action_items: DOC: align field name across spec/review_request — endpoint expects 'gdpr_consent' (not 'gdpr'). Optionally add an alias to accept 'gdpr' as well to reduce integrator friction.

UI POLISH (low priority): fix React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in ImmocloudApp.jsx line ~375 ('Locali minimi' select dynamic options). No functional impact but pollutes console.

ENHANCEMENT (optional): cron run-all does not seem to return per-search detail (which user got which emails) — current shape {ok,searches_checked,emails_sent,total_matches,run_at} is fine for now; consider adding 'failures: int' counter so [EMAIL ERROR] cases (Resend test-mode rejection, etc.) are visible from the cron response.
critical_code_review_comments: OK: /api/cloud/me/saved-searches router properly enforces _ensure_b2c() on every endpoint (403 b2c_account_required) and Depends(get_current_user) (401 without cookie). Limit of 10 enforced via count_documents before insert.
OK: _strip(doc) excludes _id; list endpoint uses projection {'_id':0}. Pydantic SearchFilters has range constraints (ge=0) and enum on operation/energy_class.

OK: run_all_active_saved_searches() respects notification_channels: 'email' must be in user's list, else search is skipped (still updates last_run_at via the final $set — wait, actually NO: looking again, line 277-281 use `continue` BEFORE the update_one at 304, so users without 'email' channel will have stale last_run_at forever. MINOR: this means if a user later flips notification_channels to include 'email', the first run after that will email them every property ever created. Likely acceptable for v1 but worth a TODO.
OK: cron endpoint validates role membership in {super_admin, platform_admin, admin}. AccountDashboard.jsx correctly redirects non-B2C users in useEffect.
OK: SavedSearchUpdate uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so PATCH with only one field updates only that field. updated_at always refreshed.
MINOR (UX): AccountDashboard renders filter tags as raw key:value chips (e.g., 'city: Roma', 'price_max: 300000'). Could use i18n labels for better UX, but does not block release.
MINOR (performance): list_saved_searches caps at length=50 but UI does not paginate. Since limit is 10 per user this is fine today; should be revisited if cap grows.
